verdict.rationale: Wave is small-business accounting software, so agent-driven month-end reconciliation is a fair axis. The evidence only documents auto-importing, merging and categorizing bank transactions on the Pro plan, which is an adjacent feature. Nothing in the pack shows an agent, reconciliation matching, exception flagging, or close preparation for human review, and the API/MCP surface is undocumented (developer portal returned 403, no llms.txt or OpenAPI).

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
